parameters.name: ArchitectureType
parameters.description: The processor architecture.

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

- **true**: Enabled.
- **false**: Disabled. This is the default value.

> This parameter does not take effect for pay-as-you-go instances.

parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:
- POST: pay-as-you-go.
- PRE: subscription.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description:
The subscription duration.

> This parameter is required when ChargeType is set to PRE.

parameters.name: Extra
parameters.description: The extended field.

parameters.name: Ha
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use zone-disaster recovery resources.

parameters.name: HaResourceSpec
parameters.description: The zone-disaster recovery resource specifications.

parameters.name: HaVSwitchIds
parameters.description: The list of vSwitch IDs in the secondary zone for zone-disaster recovery.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The workspace name. The name must start with a lowercase letter and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). The name cannot end with a hyphen.

parameters.name: MonitorType
parameters.description: The type of monitoring and alerting service. You can select ARMS or CloudMonitor.

parameters.name: PricingCycle
parameters.description:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

- **year**: year.
- **month**: month.

> This parameter is required when ChargeType is set to PRE.

parameters.name: PromotionCode
parameters.description: The coupon code.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: ResourceSpec
parameters.description:
The resource specifications.

> This parameter is required when ChargeType is set to PRE.

parameters.name: Storage
parameters.description: The storage parameters.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be specified.

parameters.name: UsePromotionCode
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:
- true: Use a coupon.
- false: Do not use a coupon.

parameters.name: VSwitchIds
parameters.description: The list of vSwitch IDs.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID.
